title: Dynamic num_slots scaling by DODAG size
description: BR root SHOULD increase num_slots proportional to DODAG size: num_slots = MAX(8, CEIL(dodag_size / 25)). At 200 nodes with 8 slots, each slot holds 25 nodes. At 32 slots, each holds ~6. Root tracks DODAG size via DAO count. Spec: 05-routing.md §9.10.4. Rust and C BR implementations.
